name: Touki Inbaku -Youbatsunin Shokushu Ryoujoku-
original_name: 闘姫淫縛 -妖伐忍・触手凌辱-
source:
A time-honored organization known as the Beautiful Punishers uses martial arts to fight the demons of our modern world.

This game follows the story of a man with the power to control tentacled monsters, despite being the head of the Beautiful Punishers. He uses his abilities to violate and break beautiful female ninjas as prey for the tentacled beasts...
This ADV recreates the story of the treacherous head of the Beautiful Punishers.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032644.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个名为“美丽惩罚者”的历史悠久的组织利用武术来对抗现代世界的恶魔。

这款游戏讲述了一个拥有控制触手怪物的能力的男人的故事，尽管他是美丽惩罚者的负责人。他利用自己的能力侵犯、摧残美丽的女忍者，让她们成为触手兽的猎物……
本ADV再现了美丽惩罚者奸诈首领的故事。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032644.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
